_comment: Contract: text_variants are ascending and the last satisfied wins, so vault_construct_downed must follow horns_party_formed, and door_retrieved (spec 8's past-tense arm) must follow both. It lives HERE, on the inn/dungeon hub, NOT on the camp's graph: the camp NPC carries a SEPARATE graph, so an arm written into this file could never render there. Its hub is `ceria_inn_returned`, gated on door_mounted, so the arm is first reachable at the mounting, never during the dig. Task 2.2: this hub is also the `horns_dig` START surface -- the invitation gates on seal_kept_reported and retires itself on horns_dig_started, the counter it banks. SPOILER RULE: no dig_* line names a door.

hub.speaker: Ceria
hub.text: You're the one Olesm's paying to poke the gallery? Good. The Guild sent us along to make sure you come back out. Ceria Springwalker — Horns of Hammerad.

text_variants.text: All right. Four of us on the roster, three of us actually walking in — Pisces bills from a distance. Try to keep up.
It was guarding a door. Wonderful. Somebody left a construct in the dark to watch one door, and we still don't know what's on the other side.
Still can't believe we carried that thing across the floodplains. Erin's already put a tablecloth on the pedestal guardian.

options.text: Heard your team's digging east of the gate road.

rules.speaker: Ceria
rules.text: Rules are simple. Traps kill more adventurers than monsters do, so nobody touches anything shiny. See something worth grabbing, you call me over and you wait.

dig_pitch._comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.2): the horns_dig pitch. The quest + horns_dig_started already banked on the option that reached here, so both exits below are ungated -- the invitation cannot be re-taken (hub's hide_when) and cannot strand the player (dig_directions repeats the camp's location, and Task 2.3's camp NPC gates on horns_dig_started, not on hearing this node).
dig_pitch.speaker: Ceria
dig_pitch.text: Word travels. Yes — there's a ruin out past the floodplains, and under it a level nobody's opened since before Liscor had walls. We hit the seal three days ago. Yvlon can't cut it, and the one mage in this city who could read it works for himself and charges accordingly. We need one more pair of hands.

dig_unknown.speaker: Ceria
dig_unknown.text: If I knew, I wouldn't need a dig. Whatever it is, someone sealed it on purpose and did a very good job. Usually that means valuable or it means dangerous. I plan the camp for dangerous.

dig_directions.speaker: Ceria
dig_directions.text: East past the gate road, across the floodplains — follow the survey stakes. Ask for me at the camp. And bring your own rope.
